posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Seeing Kronz on a cover is really great. Somehow.

Time, as they say, is a weird soup.

You know, until Christopher mentioned S’sdari, I forgot that they might have a reason not to like each other. D: Now I’m sad! And they’re gonna flip by the end? DX I regret my vote! Let! Them! Be! Friends!

I’m so proud of Christopher for recognizing “Dress Size” as a ship name before I could even start writing this note.

Being upset that someone died, not because they’re dead, but because you’ve only got two hostages now, is hilarious. XD

Who could the minor not-a-hero be? Time for fandom conspiracies!

Ah, so the third element is a snatching a Ruin from the Grey.

I feel like the sudden creation of the Lauretians is going to open up a whole can of fan question worms, and I’m here for it.

Ruin being earnestly positive and the most level-headed person in this story is everything I didn’t know I wanted. XD Vote unregretted!

Them not knowing if he’s even actually dead is somehow even better.

Clearing up the steampunk thing with Fashion is very helpful, I’ve basically been confused about her ever since they said that. Thank you for that!

I definitely want Silver Age comics, everyone else is wrong! :V

Australians don’t use rhyming slang? o_O Do they??

Ooh, on-request musical stings!

How did they know I’m sitting at home in a chair?

…Okay, but it sounds like maybe they should make Bunker’s helmet out of notshootium? c_c Maybe the whole suit??

Oh, my aching Sk8Mark!
